text.tspan: S15 — in-screen actions & state changes (no navigation)
✓ Start work: Open → In progress [status Open]
✓ Mark as resolved: In progress → Resolved [status In progress; note required]
✓ Verify & close: Resolved → Verified [status Resolved and user.isAdmin] — ADMIN
✓ Inspector at Resolved: 'Only an admin can verify this fix.' [status Resolved, inspector]
• Admin: change priority (resets the due date) [user.isAdmin and not Verified] — ADMIN

text.tspan: CORRECTIVE-ACTION LIFECYCLE — S15 status changes (one action per failed item, created on Submit in S11)
Not fixed: send back + comment (D06, ADMIN only)
Each step writes an ActionEventEntity (who / when / note), listed under History on S15.
Until VERIFIED, admins can also reassign the responsible person, change priority (resets the due date) or pick a due date (D14/D15).
Inspectors at RESOLVED see 'Only an admin can verify this fix.' — enforced in the UI and in InspectionRepository.requireAdmin().
Return after save / photo (popBackStack to the opener)
← / system Back → previous screen on the stack
Opens a pop-up / menu / permission prompt
Hands off to Android / another app / server
✓ in an arrow label, or '✓ RUN' on a screen = exercised in the Android 16 emulator walkthrough; everything else is traced in source.
ADMIN dashed outline inside a frame = control rendered only when user.isAdmin. Dashed tray under a frame = that screen's pop-ups
Every screen with ← (and the system Back gesture) returns to the previous screen via NavController.popBackStack(); only
Hover a frame or arrow in the .drawio/.svg to see its route, source file:line, roles and verification status.
